ffbp.py.summary: Small file utilities in one CLI.
details: Subcommands: ``clean-bak`` deletes the ``.bak`` files recursively, ``extinfo`` counts the files and total size of an extension, ``find-scripts`` finds the Python scripts without an extension and ``prefix``/``search`` list the entries of the current directory by prefix or substring.

Subcommands: ``analyze`` prints the line statistics, ``sort-dedupe`` sorts and/or removes the duplicate lines (case-insensitive, reversed and range options), ``dedupe-seq`` drops the adjacent duplicates, ``drop-same-char`` removes the separator lines and ``dedupe-json`` deduplicates a JSON list of objects. The large files are read through an mmap.

file_mover_tool.py.summary: Collect, flatten and move files and directories.
details: Subcommands: ``collect`` gathers every ``*.EXT`` into one folder, ``move-subdirs`` moves the top-level directories, ``flatten`` lifts the files out of the subdirectories, ``move-tests`` pulls the test folders out of ``site-packages``, ``move-binary`` collects the binaries (with SHA-256 dedup) and ``send`` copies files to a destination. Every move is logged and ``--reverse`` undoes them.

filefixer.py.summary: Detect and fix file-extension mismatches, or extract Python-like lines.
details: The ``fix`` subcommand sniffs each file (shebang, puremagic, libmagic, filetype, ``file``, signatures, mimetypes) and renames the ones whose suffix does not match, ``validate`` checks a set of binary/text extensions and ``extract-python`` pulls the Python-looking lines out of a mixed file; ``--apply``/``--confirm`` control the renames.

find_dup_func_class_const.py.summary: Find and consolidate the duplicate functions, classes and constants of a tree.
details: Hashes the top-level definitions with ast, groups the identical ones and with ``-m`` writes them into ``dh.py``, removing the copies from the sources and adding the imports they need.

fix_encoding.py.summary: Detect the text file encodings and convert everything to UTF-8 with LF endings.
details: Reads each text file through charset_normalizer/binaryornot, converts the non-UTF-8 content, normalises the CRLF line endings (``--no-dos2unix`` keeps them), can strip the BOM and offers ``--dry-run``, ``--backup``, ``--preserve-mtime``, include/exclude globs and a size limit.

fix_is_not.py.summary: Find (and optionally replace) the ``is not`` comparisons of Python files with ``!=``.
details: Tokenizes every file, reports the ``is not`` occurrences and with ``-a`` rewrites them as ``!=``, working through the tree with a thread pool.

Finds the deprecated node constructors and the ``visit_Str``/``visit_Num``-style visitor methods, rewrites them with the right value type, and supports ``--apply`` (dry run by default), ``--diff``, ``--backup``, ``--stdin``, ``--json``, include/exclude globs and a verbose per-fix listing.

fixescape.py.summary: Find and fix the invalid escape sequences of Python string literals.
details: Compiles each file with the warnings promoted to errors, locates the offending literals with tokenize, asks to make them raw or to double the backslash and with ``-a`` applies the fixes in a pool.

fixext.py.summary: Detect and fix the file extensions that do not match the MIME type.
details: Uses libmagic for each file, maps the MIME type to the expected suffix (falling back to the shebang), renames the mismatches in parallel and can ask before each ``-i`` rename.

fixwhlnames.py.summary: Restore the real names of batch-renamed wheel files.
details: Reads the ``METADATA`` and ``WHEEL`` files inside each ``.whl``, reconstructs the ``name-version-python-abi-platform`` name from the tags and renames the file accordingly; it is a dry run unless ``--apply`` is given, and the originals are backed up in ``whl_backup``.

flatten_only_children.py.summary: Flatten the only-child subdirectory chains and remove the empty directories.
details: Repeatedly moves the single subdirectory of a directory up to its parent, then deletes the empty directories bottom-up under the given root.

fmt_toml.py.summary: Format the TOML files of a tree with tree-sitter.
details: Parses and re-emits each ``.toml`` file with the configured indentation (``--indent``) and line width (``--column-width``), validates the result before writing and processes the files in parallel.
